MEXICO...
 
 
SUMMARY OF 500 PM MST...0000 UTC...INFORMATION
----------------------------------------------
LOCATION...20.3N 106.9W
ABOUT 80 MI...125 KM W OF CABO CORRIENTES MEXICO
ABOUT 205 MI...325 KM S OF MAZATLAN MEXICO
MAXIMUM SUSTAINED WINDS...100 MPH...155 KM/H
PRESENT MOVEMENT...WNW OR 300 DEGREES AT 3 MPH...6 KM/H
MINIMUM CENTRAL PRESSURE...969 MB...28.62 INCHES
 
 
WATCHES AND WARNINGS
--------------------
CHANGES WITH THIS ADVISORY:
 
None.
 
SUMMARY OF WATCHES AND WARNINGS IN EFFECT:
 
A Hurricane Warning is in effect for...
* Las Islas Marias
 
A Hurricane Watch is in effect for...
* Cabo Corrientes to Bahia Tempehuaya
 
A Hurricane Warning means that hurricane conditions are expected
somewhere within the warning area. Preparations to protect life
and property should be rushed to completion.
 
A Hurricane Watch means that hurricane conditions are possible
within the watch area within 48 hours.
 
Interests elsewhere in west-central Mexico should continue to
monitor as changes to watches and warnings are possible later today.
 
For storm information specific to your area, please monitor
products issued by your national meteorological service.
 
 
DISCUSSION AND OUTLOOK
----------------------
At 500 PM MST (0000 UTC), the center of Hurricane Simon was located
near latitude 20.3 North, longitude 106.9 West. Simon is moving
toward the west-northwest near 3 mph (6 km/h). A turn to the 
northwest is expected to occur later tonight, followed by a turn to 
the northeast shortly thereafter. On the forecast track, Simon is
expected to be near Las Islas Marias tonight into Tuesday, and then
approach the west-central Mexico coastline Wednesday and Thursday.
 
Maximum sustained winds are near 100 mph (155 km/h) with higher 
gusts.  Weakening is forecast over the next day or so, but Simon 
could re-intensify some by Wednesday and is forecast to remain a 
hurricane through midweek. Rapid weakening is likely after Simon 
moves inland late this week.
 
Simon is a compact system. Hurricane-force winds extend outward up 
to 10 miles (20 km) from the center and tropical-storm-force winds 
extend outward up to 45 miles (75 km).
 
The estimated minimum central pressure is 969 mb (28.62 inches).
 
 
HAZARDS AFFECTING LAND
----------------------
Key messages for Simon can be found in the Tropical Cyclone
Discussion under AWIPS header MIATCDEP5 and WMO header WTPZ45 KNHC.
 
WIND: Hurricane conditions are likely to occur in Las Islas Marias 
beginning tonight into Tuesday. Hurricane conditions are possible 
within the watch area on Wednesday, with tropical storm conditions 
possible by Tuesday night.
 
RAINFALL: Simon is expected to produce rainfall totals of 5 to 10
inches across coastal west-central Mexico with isolated maximum
amounts of 15 inches over the state of Sinaloa by Thursday.
 
For a complete depiction of forecast rainfall associated with Simon,
please see the National Weather Service Storm Total Rainfall Graphic
available at hurricanes.gov/graphics_ep5.shtml?rainqpf.
 
STORM SURGE: A dangerous storm surge is possible along the immediate
coast near Las Islas Marias. Near the coast, the surge will be
accompanied by large and destructive waves.
 
SURF: Swells generated by Simon will affect portions of the coast
of southwestern and west-central Mexico during the next few days.
These swells are likely to cause life-threatening surf and rip
current conditions. Please consult products from your local weather
office.
 
 
NEXT ADVISORY
-------------
Next complete advisory at 800 PM MST.
 
$$
Forecaster Evans/Cangialosi
